lenses.name: Private-sector jobs
lenses.description: URSSAF private-sector salaried jobs at employer establishments per 100 km², general regime. Jobs are counted at workplace establishments, not residence.

lenses.name: Private employers
lenses.description: URSSAF private-sector employer establishments per 100 km². Blank source cells are suppressed or unavailable and are not treated as zero.

lenses.name: Industrial private jobs
lenses.description: Share of URSSAF private-sector salaried jobs in industry (GS1). This is workplace-industry composition, not all employment.

lenses.name: Service private jobs
lenses.description: Share of URSSAF private-sector salaried jobs in other market and non-market services (GS5/GS7), excluding commerce, construction, hospitality and temporary-work categories.
